newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians protest closure of Hebron University.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians protest closure of Hebron University.

text.p: Hundreds of Palestinians demonstrated outside Hebron University on Monday demanding the reopening of the institution closed by Israel since March, witnesses said.
They said Israeli soldiers surrounded the university building and pushed back demonstrators to prevent them from entering the campus.

Students and teachers carried banners demanding the resumption of studies halted after a wave of suicide bombings by Moslem militants last February and March which killed 59 people in the Jewish state.
Palestinians clashed with Israeli troops last week in Hebron outside the closed university and the Hebron Polytechnic college. Israel allowed a partial reopening of the college on Sunday.

An Israeli army spokesman said the opening of two buildings at the Polytechnic college in Hebron was part of a gradual process of easing the measure and followed talks between army officers and residents of Hebron, a flashpoint of Arab-Israeli violence.
Israel agreed to hand over about 80 percent of Hebron to Palestinian self-rule under a peace deal signed more than a year ago but its long-overdue partial pullout has yet to take place.

In the West Bank town of Qalqilya, joint PLO-Israeli patrols resumed on Monday for the first time since clashes in the West Bank and Gaza last September in which 60 Palestinians and 15 Israeli soldiers were killed.
A senior PLO security official said the resumption of the joint patrols followed a meeting on Sunday between senior PLO and Israeli security officials.
